title: NDA Guidance
content: Mutual NDAs are available from Legal via the contract portal. Do not share Confidential information with third parties without a signed NDA. Customer NDAs must be reviewed by Legal before signature if non-standard terms are requested.

title: Contract Review Process
content: All contracts above $50,000 or with unusual liability terms require Legal review. Submit via the Legal intake form with the draft and business summary. Standard turnaround is 5 business days.

title: Intellectual Property
content: Work product created in the course of employment is company IP. Open-source contributions require Legal and Engineering approval. Do not use customer data to train external models without approval.

title: Litigation Hold
content: If you receive a litigation hold notice, preserve all related documents and email. Do not delete, alter, or auto-purge relevant data. Questions go only to Legal — do not discuss the matter broadly.

title: Data Breach Response
content: Suspected data breaches must be reported immediately to Legal and Security. Do not notify customers yourself. Legal coordinates regulatory notification timelines. This is always high severity.

title: Employment Claims
content: Threats of lawsuits, discrimination claims, or termination disputes must be escalated to Legal and HR immediately. Do not admit liability or offer settlements without Legal guidance.

title: Marketing Claims Review
content: Public product claims, case studies, and logos of customers require Legal review before publication. Customer quotes need documented approval from the customer.

title: Export Controls
content: Certain software and technical data may be export-controlled. Do not share controlled technology with restricted countries or parties. Contact Legal before international transfers of sensitive technical materials.
